### MaosaicoState

```ts
type MaosaicoState = Readonly<State> & object;
```

Live layout projection and commands; each state instance owns its store.

#### Type Declaration

| Name                 | Type                                                                    | Description                                                              |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `version`            | `number`                                                                | Revision incremented by store updates.                                   |
| `subscribe()`        | (`listener`) => () => `void`                                            | Observe store changes; returns an unsubscribe function.                  |
| `register()`         | (`id`, `frame`, `minima`) => `void`                                     | Register or replace a pane's frame and minima, including it in layout.   |
| `setParticipation()` | (`id`, `participating`) => `void`                                       | Include or exclude a registered pane without discarding its frame.       |
| `setMinima()`        | (`id`, `minima`) => `void`                                              | Update minimum dimensions for an existing pane.                          |
| `unregister()`       | (`id`) => `void`                                                        | Remove a pane, its ordering, restoration frame and active gesture.       |
| `begin()`            | (`id`, `pointerId`) => `void`                                           | Capture a participating pane's starting frame for a pointer gesture.     |
| `move()`             | (`id`, `pointerId`, `frame`, `bounds`, `minima`, `snapSide?`) => `void` | Update the owning pointer's clamped frame and optional snap preview.     |
| `end()`              | (`id`, `pointerId`) => `void`                                           | Finish the owning pointer's gesture, applying its snap if present.       |
| `cancel()`           | (`id`, `pointerId`) => `void`                                           | Restore the owning pointer's starting frame and clear its gesture.       |
| `snap()`             | (`id`, `side`, `bounds`, `minima`) => `void`                            | Snap a participating pane and retain its previous frame.                 |
| `restoreFrame()`     | (`id`, `bounds`, `minima`) => `void`                                    | Restore a retained floating frame, clamped to current bounds and minima. |
| `focus()`            | (`id`) => `void`                                                        | Move a registered pane to the top of focus order.                        |
| `swap()`             | (`first`, `second`) => `void`                                           | Exchange two participating panes' positions in tiling order.             |
| `zoom()`             | (`id`) => `void`                                                        | Expand a participating pane, or clear expansion with null.               |
| `resizeMain()`       | (`size`) => `void`                                                      | Clear the preference with undefined to restore the default half.         |
| `beginDivider()`     | (`pointerId`) => `boolean`                                              | Start a divider gesture only when no other gesture is active.            |
| `finishDivider()`    | (`pointerId`, `cancel`) => `void`                                       | Finish the owning divider gesture, restoring its preference on cancel.   |
| `destroy()`          | () => `void`                                                            | Clear the current gesture and retained restoration frames.               |

### Arrangement

```ts
type Arrangement = object;
```
